items.text: Less used fields in the homebrew form are hidden behind an advanced toggle, so the form is easier to fill in
English is now the default language instead of Dutch
Pop-ups and confirmation windows now open and close with a smooth animation
Added more automated checks behind the scenes to catch problems before they reach you
Everything you type is now checked more carefully before it is saved, keeping your data safer
The number of encounters shown could be wrong and no longer match the encounters you actually have
The border of a selected input field was cut off inside pop-ups
